root_cause: Conflating two semantically distinct outcomes ('holder not found' vs 'graph building aborted') into a single sentinel return value, so the caller cannot detect that the compiler has entered a dead/aborted state and must stop emitting nodes.
findings: TryInferApiHolderValue() returns a plain compiler::HolderLookupResult. When inference.InsertMapChecks(zone()) detects that graph building has aborted (e.g. because a required map check could not be safely inserted and the current basic block was terminated/nulled), the function collapses this distinct 'abort' condition into the same 'not_found' sentinel value that it also returns for the ordinary,
